cross_section.spillover_signal: signal_k = tox_z[OTHER](k) * atm_iv_z[OTHER](k)  (interaction of the other asset's order-flow toxicity z and near-ATM IV z)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar interaction of the OTHER underlying's z-scored options order-flow toxicity and near-ATM implied-vol level (e62.build_states tox_signal='tox' x e71.build_surface_bars atm_iv — SURFACE bar, not the term bar), aligned to the common BTC-vs-ETH bar grid, forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward expected shortfall (CVaR) = mean of the worst CVAR_ALPHA-tail over the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, r_i=log(close_i/close_{i-1}) over i in k+1..k+H); transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-168
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_interaction_z_k, own_cvar_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher other-asset order-flow toxicity x atm_iv interaction -> higher forward expected shortfall (CVaR) on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
